home.practice_overload_blurb: Tap a capacitor to charge it. A full one bursts into its neighbours, and one chain of ten beats two of five.
overload.title: Overload
overload.how_to: Tap a capacitor to add one charge. At four it bursts and passes one charge to each neighbour above, below, left and right; a neighbour that reaches four bursts next. A chain of n bursts scores n times n. Taps are scarce: you hold five and one comes back every two and a half seconds. A tap that bursts nothing still charges, so spend one to join two clusters before you set them off.
overload.how_to_keyboard: Arrows or WASD move the cursor. Space or enter taps.
overload.streak_note: A chain of four or more builds a streak that multiplies every chain, a quarter more each time, up to triple. A shorter chain breaks it. A tap that bursts nothing does not.
overload.refund_note: Every four bursts in a chain give a tap back.
overload.hint_note: Practice rounds mark a tap worth making when you pause: a ring for a chain, a plus for a charge that sets one up.
overload.legend_booster: Booster, with a second ring and four lugs. It passes two charges to each neighbour when it bursts.
overload.legend_ring: The ring round a capacitor is cut in three: one lit part for each charge. A capacitor at three shows a bolt. A capacitor goes when its charge plus its bursting neighbours reach four, and it bursts once in a chain.
